extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1950s two-seat roadster, approx. 4.4 x 1.8 x 1.1 m (L x W x H incl. windshield), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic, brand-free open 1950s roadster: cherry red with cream side coves, chrome-framed windshield, two seats, streamlined headrest fairings, small tail fins, oval chrome grille, whitewall tyres; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); open cockpit with padded rim, dashboard and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
